 "data": "%% UavPms - System Architecture\n%% Reference: system-architecture.drawio.svg (page \"System_Architecture\")\n%% Synced with: docker-compose.yml, UavPms.ApiGateway/ocelot.json, Shared/UavPms.Shared.Contracts\nflowchart TB\n\n %% ================= CLIENT =================\n subgraph Client[\"Client\"]\n direction LR\n Angular[\"Angular SPA\"]\n Drone[\"UAV / Drone\"]\n end\n\n %% ================= GATEWAY =================\n subgraph Gateway[\"Gateway\"]\n Ocelot[\"Ocelot API Gateway<br/>(UavPms.ApiGateway :5194)\"]\n end\n\n %% ================= SERVICES =================\n subgraph Services[\"Services (.NET - Clean Architecture: API / Application / Domain / Infrastructure)\"]\n direction LR\n Identity[\"IdentityService<br/>auth, users, audit-logs\"]\n Operations[\"OperationsService<br/>towers, regions, missions, UAVs,<br/>inspections, maintenance, monitor, GIS\"]\n AIInspection[\"AIInspectionService<br/>ai-analysis, vision, anomalies, alerts\"]\n Notification[\"NotificationService<br/>notifications, SignalR hub, Hangfire jobs\"]\n Evaluation[\"InspectionEvaluationService<br/>(gRPC only)\"]\n end\n\n PyWorker[\"Python AI Service<br/>(FastAPI - fastapi-ai :8000)\"]\n\n %% ================= INFRASTRUCTURE =================\n subgraph Infrastructure[\"Infrastructure\"]\n direction LR\n RabbitMQ[[\"RabbitMQ<br/>exchange: uavpms.events<br/>(legacy: identity-exchange)\"]]\n Mosquitto[[\"Mosquitto<br/>MQTT broker\"]]\n PostgreSQL[(\"PostgreSQL<br/>service DBs + Hangfire\")]\n Redis[(\"Redis<br/>cache / live state\")]\n Minio[(\"MinIO<br/>bucket: uav-media\")]\n end\n\n subgraph External[\"External\"]\n direction LR\n Brevo[\"Brevo<br/>(email)\"]\n SendGrid[\"SendGrid<br/>(email)\"]\n end\n\n %% ---------- Client -> Gateway ----------\n Angular -- \"HTTPS REST / WebSocket\" --> Ocelot\n Drone -- \"MQTT uav/+/status, uav/+/telemetry\" --> Mosquitto\n\n %% ---------- Gateway -> Services (HTTP) ----------\n Ocelot --> Identity\n Ocelot --> Operations\n Ocelot --> AIInspection\n Ocelot -- \"REST + /hubs/notifications\" --> Notification\n\n %% ---------- Service <-> Service ----------\n AIInspection -- \"gRPC\" --> Evaluation\n AIInspection -- \"HTTP REST API (PythonAI:BaseUrl)\" --> PyWorker\n\n %% ---------- Messaging ----------\n Identity -- \"publish\" --> RabbitMQ\n Operations <-- \"inspection.media.uploaded, mission.dispatched,<br/>maintenance.ticket.assigned / ai.detection.completed\" --> RabbitMQ\n AIInspection <-- \"inspection.media.uploaded / ai.detection.completed\" --> RabbitMQ\n RabbitMQ -- \"consume: ai.detection.completed, mission.*,<br/>maintenance.ticket.assigned, assessments\" --> Notification\n Mosquitto -- \"MQTT subscribe\" --> Operations\n\n %% ---------- Data stores ----------\n Identity --> PostgreSQL\n Operations --> PostgreSQL\n AIInspection --> PostgreSQL\n Notification --> PostgreSQL\n\n Identity --> Redis\n Operations --> Redis\n AIInspection --> Redis\n Notification --> Redis\n\n Operations -- \"S3 API\" --> Minio\n AIInspection -- \"S3 API\" --> Minio\n PyWorker -- \"read media\" --> Minio\n\n %% ---------- External ----------\n Identity -- \"HTTP\" --> Brevo\n Notification -- \"HTTP\" --> SendGrid\n\n %% ================= STYLES =================\n classDef client fill:#E3F2FD,stroke:#1E88E5,color:#0D47A1\n classDef gateway fill:#FFF3E0,stroke:#FB8C00,color:#E65100\n classDef service fill:#E8F5E9,stroke:#43A047,color:#1B5E20\n classDef worker fill:#F3E5F5,stroke:#8E24AA,color:#4A148C\n classDef infra fill:#ECEFF1,stroke:#546E7A,color:#263238\n classDef external fill:#FFFDE7,stroke:#F9A825,color:#5D4037,stroke-dasharray: 4 3\n\n class Angular,Drone client\n class Ocelot gateway\n class Identity,Operations,AIInspection,Notification,Evaluation service\n class PyWorker worker\n class RabbitMQ,Mosquitto,PostgreSQL,Redis,Minio infra\n class Brevo,SendGrid external\n\n",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
